name: Litigation Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
IL1S

  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Litigation Committee will conduct
  a Special Meeting, at the following time and place, and will address
  the agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th
  Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Friday, May 2, 2025
  9:00AM

  AMENDED AGENDA

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item not listed on the agenda

  2) Insurance Renewal Strategy

  3) Outside Counsel Request for Rate Increase  —  Walsworth

  4) Discussion of City Prosecutor Services

  5) Adjournment

  Huma Ahmed
  City Clerk

  Posted: April 28, 2025

  Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable efforts to
  accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1014
  (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least twenty-four (24) hours advance notice will help to
  ensure availability of services. City Hall, including the 4th Floor Conference Room A, is wheelchair
  accessible.
